defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into incoming magic damage to soak up to 30% of your health and block harmful magic effects.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for the biggest hits and for stun mechanics, since it cuts all damage taken by 30%.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the group for a scripted magic hit to cut the raid's magic damage by 15%.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to break charm, fear and sleep effects, or for the extra leech through sustained damage.

defensives.name: Death Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Press it when no heal is coming, since it restores half your health but blocks incoming healing while it lasts.

defensives.name: Death's Advance
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before knockbacks and forced movement, or to cover a long run without losing uptime.
